changes.comment: Fix `getDetailedRepoStateAsync` and `RepoStateCache` for paths that `git hash-object` can't read. A path whose working tree column in `git status` is blank, such as a staged file that a sparse checkout leaves out or that the index marks "assume unchanged" or "skip worktree", now keeps the object in the index, and a staged symbolic link stays in `symlinks`. So a staged "assume unchanged" or "skip worktree" file that differs on disk now gets the object in the index, not the hash of the file on disk. A symbolic link that doesn't lead to a regular file, such as one whose target is missing, now gets the hash of its text instead of failing, or of waiting forever for a named pipe.
